:::{#exm-cv-choice-inputs}
#### Inputs of the cross-validation choice procedure

The [cross-validation choice procedure](#def-cv-choice) $\fitproc$ over polynomials of several degrees has these inputs:

- [data set](#def-data-set) $\dataset$: the observations the candidates are fitted and scored on;
- [model family](#def-model-family) $\modelfam$: the polynomials of every candidate degree;
- [objective function](#def-objective-function) $\objfn$: the residual sum of squares within each candidate, and the [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate-indexed) between candidates;
- [optimization algorithm](#def-optimization-algorithm) $\optalg$: the normal equations for each candidate, then keeping the candidate with the smallest cross-validation estimate of its [expected generalization error](#def-expected-generalization-error) $\expgenerr{\candproc{\polydeg}}{\nobs}$;
- [random seed](#def-random-seed) $\seed$: fixes the random [fold assignment](#def-fold-assignment);
- [tuning parameter](#def-tuning-parameter) $\tuning$: none, since cross-validation chooses the degree;
- [preprocessing](#def-preprocessing) $\featmap$: none.

:::
